name: SendFox
description: SendFox is an email marketing platform for creators and small teams to organize contact lists, build campaigns and automations, publish forms, and track audience growth.
agentUseSummary: Connect one exact paid SendFox account through Relay-owned OAuth, then let agents inspect approval-gated, bounded account, contact-list aggregate, and campaign lifecycle metadata without exposing contacts or message content.

capabilities.label: Read marketing lifecycle metadata
capabilities.description: Read bounded account, list aggregate, and campaign lifecycle metadata for one exact paid SendFox account.

approvalRequired.label: Read account summary
approvalRequired.description: Read the exact SendFox user ID, contact count, contact limit, and account creation date without returning the user's name or email.

approvalRequired.label: List contact-list summaries
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty-five SendFox contact-list aggregate summaries from the first provider page.

approvalRequired.label: List campaign lifecycle
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty-five recent SendFox campaign lifecycle summaries without subject, preview, HTML, sender, recipient, or engagement data.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Every bounded SendFox metadata read requires approval; contacts, message content, sender and recipient identity, engagement, forms, automations, domains, exports, webhooks, writes, sends, and raw API access remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The three bounded SendFox metadata reads run without Relay per-action approval; exact-account binding, redaction, first-page bounds, audits, and rate limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts three exact-account, approval-aware SendFox metadata reads and attaches the OAuth token server-side.
Relay mounts three exact-account, approval-aware SendFox metadata reads and attaches the OAuth token server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay's SendFox OAuth Client, paid staging account, and production client credentials are not configured yet.
providerSetup.nextAction: Using the separate provider-console task, create Relay's OAuth Client with the Railway callback, store SENDFOX_CLIENT_ID and SENDFOX_CLIENT_SECRET in Railway, deploy, and run live consent, exact-account reads, policy, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial checks with a paid SendFox account.

evidence.supports: SendFox documents confidential OAuth Client registration, an exact redirect URL, the authorization-code grant, and its authorization and token endpoints; API features require a paid plan.
SendFox documents the fixed API origin, GET /me, paginated Lists and Campaigns, a 60-request-per-minute per-user limit, standard errors, and broad write/send surfaces that Relay excludes.
SendFox documents GET /me, /lists, and /campaigns and confirms that free accounts receive HTTP 402 for API access.

securityNotes: OAuth is provider-wide and SendFox documents no granular scopes; Relay compensates with three approval-aware metadata-only tools.
Relay stores the OAuth access token encrypted and never returns it to agents.
Runtime requests use only https://api.sendfox.com, reject redirects, cap responses at 2 MB, and enforce one request per second per exact account.
List output excludes contacts and owner IDs; Campaign output excludes title, subject, preview, HTML, sender, recipient, and engagement data.
Disconnect deletes Relay's encrypted grant; no upstream revocation endpoint or refresh-token lifecycle is claimed without official documentation.
